[P0] Keep child contexts executing through finalization

This also releases child contexts, whose terminal checkpoints are fire-and-forget. After an early batch decision drops a losing child's checkpoint, `executeChildContext` still runs its end hook and awaits `safeDeserialize`, but this change has already marked it `COMPLETED`. Once the winning item settles, a pending wait or callback can suspend the invocation during that deserialization, losing its error or allowing its continuation to run after the invocation returns. This violates SDK invariants 1 and 2, and the PR contains no superseding ADR. Keep child finalization `EXECUTING` through its existing `finally`; distinguish genuinely parked abandoned operations from contexts that continue running, and document any changed cancellation invariant in the required ADR.
